paragraphs: Outdoorlink sells remote monitoring and control for outdoor electrical systems and displays, managed from one central platform. The homepage names a Smart Controller for remote asset monitoring, Vantage for detecting screen issues on digital ads, and an LED Luminaire sold on reduced energy cost. The listed uses run to lights, locks, signs, water features, Wifi and digital out-of-home displays.

The industries named are Parks & Recreation, Campus, Transit, Commercial Properties, Smart Asset Management, and Digital Place Based. Case studies on the site cover a county parks and recreation department, four transit agencies, three outdoor advertising companies, and a historic landmark. Those studies name Hillsborough County Parks and Recreation Department, Kansas City Area Transportation Authority, Long Beach Transit, Orange County Transportation Authority, Lamar Advertising Company, Stott Outdoor Advertising, and Circle City Outdoor. The homepage puts the count at 1,200+ organizations that rely on Outdoorlink to manage and monitor lighting and assets.

quote.text: Take control of your electrical systems and displays with Outdoorlink. Manage, monitor, and adjust lighting, signs, water features, OOH ads, and more from one central platform in real-time.
